sources.title: KanVibe README
sources.finding: Keyboard-first macOS Kanban workspace for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode with git worktrees, terminals (Herdr/tmux/zellij), hooks, diff view, mobile companion, AGPL-3.0.

sources.title: Features page (docs site source)
sources.finding: Board, worktree view, task workspace, terminal tabs, AI chat history, live AI sessions, AI usage and accounts, quick search, notifications, hooks and mobile.

sources.title: Installation page (docs site source)
sources.finding: Install KanVibe Desktop on macOS with Homebrew cask; prerequisites git, gh, Herdr/tmux/zellij; mobile builds from source.

sources.title: Mobile guide (docs site source)
sources.finding: Flutter iOS/Android companion built from source; pairing code (6 digits, 5 minutes, single use); LAN/Tailscale reachability; foreground WebSocket; background push needs Firebase/APNs and a desktop relay.

sources.title: Settings page (docs site source)
sources.finding: Theme, pane layouts, detail page, task creation default session type, notifications, keyboard, background sync interval 1-1440 minutes, AI accounts.

sources.title: AGPL-3.0 licence text
sources.finding: GNU Affero General Public License version 3; README states AGPL-3.0 and that commercial SaaS distribution is not permitted; no or-later grant in the README.

sources.title: Desktop package manifest
sources.finding: version 1.5.5; Electron ^32.3.3; dist script builds electron-builder --mac dmg only.

sources.title: Packaging config
sources.finding: Only a mac dmg target (minimumSystemVersion 10.15.0); publish null.

sources.title: Electron main process platform branches
sources.finding: Linux branch disables GPU acceleration; macOS-specific menu/dock handling elsewhere; no Windows branch; packaging produces macOS only.

sources.title: Task entity
sources.finding: Task fields: title, description, status todo/progress/pending/review/done, branch, worktree path, session type (tmux, zellij, herdr, terminal), session name, ssh host, agent type, project, base branch, PR URL, priority.

sources.title: Project entity
sources.finding: Project name, repo path, default branch, ssh host, worktree flag, color, icon.

sources.title: createTask and status updates
sources.finding: createTask creates the git worktree and terminal session and installs hooks; updateTaskStatus and updateTask persist changes.

sources.title: Delete and branch tasks
sources.finding: deleteTaskAcrossTargets cleans worktree, branch and session (refuses dirty worktrees without force); branchFromTask creates a follow-up task from an existing branch.

sources.title: Move task and PR lookup
sources.finding: moveTaskToColumn changes status; fetchAndSavePrUrl uses gh pr list to attach a PR URL.

sources.title: PR and pull sync
sources.finding: syncActiveTaskPullRequests reads PR info with the gh CLI, records merged PRs; syncActiveTaskPulls runs git pull --ff-only on tracked repos.

sources.title: Hook status service
sources.finding: POST taskId + status (todo/progress/pending/review/done) updates the task and broadcasts; unknown task returns 404 and still notifies; tunnel-reachability check for remote hosts.

sources.title: Hook and mobile HTTP server
sources.finding: Routes /api/hooks/health, hook install script (token), /api/hooks/status, task CLI routes and /api/mobile/*; browser-origin rejection and remote-hook guard.

sources.title: Hook installer
sources.finding: Installs agent hooks for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI and OpenCode into each worktree (.claude, .gemini, .codex, .opencode plugin).

sources.title: Task CLI routes
sources.finding: POST /api/cli/tasks (create), /api/cli/tasks/delete, /api/cli/tasks/register authenticated with a per-task token.

sources.title: Task CLI service
sources.finding: createTaskFromCli creates a new branch task and worktree in the same project (409 on duplicate branch) and propagates to peer clients; deleteTaskFromCli requires confirmed:true.

sources.title: Worktree task.sh CLI
sources.finding: .kanvibe/task.sh create --branch/--title/--from-task/--session-type and delete --yes [--force] against registered KanVibe clients from targets.json.

sources.title: Mobile pairing rules
sources.finding: Six-digit single-use code valid 5 minutes with 5 failure cap; 32-byte device tokens persisted; terminal read/write requires the token while /api/hooks/status is unauthenticated.

sources.title: Mobile API routes
sources.finding: REST and WebSocket routes for board, tasks, directories, project scan, notifications, notification settings, device deletion and stream/events.

sources.title: Mobile pane write
sources.finding: writeToPane sends input to the herdr, zellij, tmux or terminal session for a task pane.

sources.title: Mobile push relay
sources.finding: Optional self-run relay that forwards desktop notification requests to FCM HTTP v1 with a bearer relayToken; configured via KANVIBE_MOBILE_PUSH_RELAY_URL/TOKEN.

sources.title: Background sync
sources.finding: While the app is open, syncs worktrees, PR state and pulls every configured interval (default 10 minutes, 20 s initial delay).

sources.title: Diff service
sources.finding: getGitDiffFiles, original/current content, saveFileContent (edit), task diff stats.

sources.title: Live AI session reader
sources.finding: Reads Claude, Codex, Gemini and OpenCode transcripts/session stores and tmux/Herdr pane processes to show running sessions and subtasks.

sources.title: AI usage readers
sources.finding: Reads each CLI stored sign-in and calls api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage, chatgpt.com wham/usage and cloudcode-pa quota endpoints to show subscription windows.

sources.title: AI account management
sources.finding: Creates per-account CLI home directories, launches the CLI login in an in-app terminal, removes accounts it created.

sources.title: Release update check
sources.finding: Checks https://api.github.com/repos/rookedsysc/kanvibe/releases (cached one hour) and shows an update dialog.

sources.title: Worktree creation
sources.finding: git worktree add -b <branch> <path> <base> locally or over SSH.

sources.title: Worktree cleanup
sources.finding: branch -D and worktree remove --force for a deleted task.

sources.title: Git pull
sources.finding: git pull --ff-only helper used by sync.

sources.title: Herdr integration
sources.finding: Herdr server/workspace/tab handling for local and SSH hosts.

sources.title: SSH config reader
sources.finding: Reads ~/.ssh/config hosts for remote projects and tasks.

sources.title: Hook tunnels
sources.finding: Reverse SSH tunnels let remote hosts post hook status to the local app; reconciled on an interval.

sources.title: Terminal sessions
sources.finding: Creates tmux, zellij, Herdr or direct PTY (terminal) sessions per task; terminal type is owned by the app and dies on quit.

sources.title: Shell environment
sources.finding: createLocalShellEnvironment strips PORT, HOST, NODE_ENV and KANVIBE_* from user shells (CLAUDE.md rule).

sources.title: Notification store
sources.finding: Persisted notification inbox shared by desktop and mobile (latest 100).

sources.title: App settings entity
sources.finding: Settings persisted in SQLite (theme, session type default, sync, notification filters, shortcuts).

sources.title: Mobile developer README
sources.finding: Flutter client (iOS and Android) that mirrors task terminal panes; build from source with fvm.

sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 151 stars at the check; AGPL-3.0; homepage kanvibe.rookedsysc.com; default branch main; pushed 2026-11-17; not archived.

sources.title: Release 1.5.5
sources.finding: Published 2026-11-12 (commit b3370c4); single asset KanVibe-1.5.5.dmg; notes describe remote Herdr registration and SSH lock fixes.

sources.title: Repository issues and PRs
sources.finding: Recent merged work on pane chat input, mobile terminal selection, Herdr scrolling and AI usage refresh; these items postdate release 1.5.5 and are not part of the pinned source; one open issue about zellij pane chat; no roadmap.

sources.title: README main board screenshot
sources.finding: First-party Kanban board screenshot used as the README hero image.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry and analytics
sources.finding: No telemetry or analytics code (hits were substrings of "SettingsEntry"); network calls are the GitHub releases check, GitHub avatar fetch, a Nerd Font CDN, provider usage endpoints for the optional usage panel and the user-configured push relay.

sources.title: Bounded search: vendor cloud and accounts
sources.finding: No vendor-hosted service or KanVibe account; OAuth appears only in AI-provider usage/sign-in helpers (Claude, Gemini) and the CLI sign-in terminal.

sources.title: Bounded search: MCP, plugins, skills, scheduling, cost, review
sources.finding: No MCP client or server (mcp only in credential key names), no skill import (the OpenCode plugin is generated for hooks), no cron or agent scheduler, no cost or budget accounting, no review approval flow; setInterval is used for tunnel reconcile, status polling, heartbeat and background sync.

sources.title: Bounded search: roles, SSO, collaboration
sources.finding: No roles, SSO or multi-user model; mobile devices pair to one desktop with device tokens and the notification inbox is shared per desktop.

sources.title: Bounded search: sandboxes and containers
sources.finding: Only the Electron Chromium no-sandbox flag for headless Linux; no container, VM or OS sandbox for agents.
